programme.desc: À Hidalgo, une jeune femme en provenance de Cuba traverse le pont dans l'espoir de demander l'asile politique aux États-Unis ; pendant ce temps, à Laredo, les agents sont surpris par la cargaison inusitée de trois étudiants en biologie.

programme.title: La frontière États-Unis-Mexique
programme.desc: Les agents font une découverte de grande valeur en inspectant de simples galons de peinture et des bouteilles de bière ; à Laredo, un adolescent ayant parcouru plus de 2 000 kilomètres à l'arrière d'un camion se fait intercepter.

programme.title: La frontière États-Unis-Mexique
programme.desc: Au pont Hidalgo, des agents interceptent une cargaison illégale de 5 000 cartouches de munitions ; pendant ce temps, à 200 kilomètres de là, une équipe d'élite se prépare à arrêter un dangereux meurtrier associé à un cartel mexicain.

programme.title: La frontière États-Unis-Mexique
programme.desc: Les douaniers croient avoir décelé une tendance chez les trafiquants lorsqu'ils arrêtent deux voitures avec des stupéfiants camouflés exactement au même endroit ; une de ces deux voitures contiendrait du fentanyl, une drogue extrêmement puissante.

programme.title: La frontière États-Unis-Mexique
programme.desc: Une nouvelle recrue des services frontaliers découvre 12 kilogrammes de cocaïne dans une voiture qui s'est arrêtée sur le pont ; aussi, les agents sont aux aguets lorsqu'un enfant est kidnappé et qu'une alerte générale est déclenchée.

programme.title: La guerre des enchères
programme.desc: Les acheteurs débarquent dans la ville natale de Dan ; l'achat de Kenny vide son portefeuille, et Brandi et Jarrod risquent leur budget de vacances.

programme.title: La guerre des enchères
programme.desc: À Victorville, le côté malicieux de Brandi et Jarrod se révèle ; Ivy s'empare d'une unité que personne ne veut et Mary remet le nouveau à sa place.

programme.title: La guerre des enchères
programme.desc: Les filles de Vegas rencontrent Dave, qui s'empare rapidement de leur entrepôt et qui leur laisse des miettes ; Kenny utilise Mary comme bouclier pour se protéger de Dave, et les deux acheteurs parviennent à mettre la main sur une unité convenable.

programme.title: La guerre des enchères
programme.desc: René parvient à acheter beaucoup d'unités à Rancho Palos Verdes; le mini-entrepôt de Mary révèle une mauvaise surprise, et Justin montre qu'il peut transformer un petit investissement en gros profit.

programme.title: La guerre des enchères
programme.desc: De retour à Adelanto, Ivy fait une trouvaille de taille; Brandi et Jarrod tâtent le terrain et leur démarche s'avère très payante; Mary gonfle son profit et goûte au succès.

programme.title: La guerre des enchères
programme.desc: Riverside croule sous une chaleur jamais vue, et Kenny commence à halluciner ; Ivy donne un coup de pouce à Mary, tandis que Shana et Edwina tombent sur quelque chose qui fait leur bonheur.

programme.title: La guerre des enchères
programme.desc: Ivy emmène les acheteurs tout près de Lancaster, et Dave profite de sa grande proximité avec lui; Rene ne tolère pas Justin, qui sort finalement gagnant.

programme.title: La guerre des enchères
programme.desc: À Placentia, les filles de Vegas testent leur propre technique pour acheter une unité ; aussi, Kenny et son frère montrent à tout le monde que, quand une bonne affaire est en jeu, la famille passe en second.

programme.title: La guerre des enchères
programme.desc: À Paramount, Justin demande les conseils d'Ivy au sujet de ses pièces de Cadillac d'époque, et Kenny regrette immédiatement d'avoir pris la parole pendant la vente aux enchères.

programme.title: La guerre des enchères
programme.desc: De retour à Orange, Kenny fait un petit saut dans le passé; Brandi et Jarrod s'affairent dans un entrepôt d'outils, et Darrell et sa petite-fille font une trouvaille lugubre.

programme.title: Mayday
programme.desc: Le Boeing 737 du vol 200 de la compagnie Garuda Indonésie atterrit sur la piste de l'aéroport international Adisutjipto si fort qu'il rebondit à deux reprises avant de sortir de la piste. Sur les 140 passagers se trouvant à bord, 21 sont tués.

programme.title: Mayday
programme.desc: Le 5 avril 1991, le vol Atlantic Southeast Airlines 2311, en provenance d'Atlanta, plonge soudain vers le sol alors qu'il effectue son approche de l'aéroport de Glynco, tuant les 23 personnes présentes à bord.

programme.title: Mayday
programme.desc: Le 31 octobre 1996, peu après son décollage de l'aéroport de Congonhas à Sao Paulo, le vol 402 de la compagnie TAM s'écrase sur un quartier résidentiel et prend feu. Cet accident tue les 95 personnes qui se trouvent à bord.

programme.title: Mayday
programme.desc: En route vers Dallas au départ d'Orlando, un Learjet privé transportant la légende du golf Payne Stewart montre un comportement délinquant; les contrôleurs aériens sont incapables de joindre l'équipage.

programme.title: Air Bud
programme.desc: Abandoned by a disagreeable clown (Michael Jeter), a golden retriever with a knack for basketball befriends a lonely boy (Kevin Zegers).

programme.title: Air Bud: Golden Receiver
programme.desc: A golden retriever with a flair for sports helps a boy (Kevin Zegers) handle football and the new boyfriend (Gregory Harrison) of the boy's widowed mother (Cynthia Stevenson).

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem
programme.desc: The Turtle brothers take on a mysterious crime syndicate, but they soon get in over their heads when an army of mutants is unleashed upon them.

programme.title: A Minecraft Movie
programme.desc: A mysterious portal pulls four misfits into the Overworld, a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master the terrain while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected crafter named Steve.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: Indy (Harrison Ford) and a young adventurer (Shia La Beouf) must ferret out a powerful artifact and keep it out of the hands of a deadly Soviet agent (Cate Blanchett).

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: In 1935 archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford), a lounge singer (Kate Capshaw) and a Chinese orphan (Ke Huy Quan) search for mystical stones stolen from an Indian tribe.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: Archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford) rescues his kidnapped father (Sean Connery), and the two race the Nazis to find the Holy Grail.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog 3
programme.desc: Sonic, Knuckles and Tails reunite to battle Shadow, a mysterious new enemy with powers unlike anything they've faced before. With their abilities outmatched in every way, they seek out an unlikely alliance to stop Shadow and protect the planet.

programme.title: Rental Family
programme.desc: An American actor lands an unusual gig with a Japanese agency to play stand-in roles for strangers. As he immerses himself in his clients' worlds, he begins to form genuine bonds that blur the lines between performance and reality.

programme.title: Tracy & Martina: Goin' Out West
programme.desc: Two Cape Breton best friends head west to Alberta for the first time with the hopes of making a few bucks as they open for a local band, but things go south when their accommodations fall through and they run out of money.

programme.title: Gladiator II
programme.desc: Lucius must enter the Colosseum after the powerful emperors of Rome conquer his home. With rage in his heart and the future of the empire at stake, he looks to the past to find the strength and honor needed to return the glory of Rome to its people.

programme.title: Oppenheimer
programme.desc: During World War II, Lt. Gen. Leslie Groves Jr. appoints physicist J. Robert Oppenheimer to work on the top-secret Manhattan Project. Oppenheimer and a team of scientists spend years developing the atomic bomb, forever changing the course of history.

programme.title: Air Bud: World Pup
programme.desc: The golden retriever helps his young owner (Kevin Zegers) and his coed soccer team to shine while outsmarting a wily dogcatcher.

programme.title: I Am Raquel Welch
programme.desc: Celebrating the life of a trailblazing actress and single mother who not only redefined the world's idea of a Hollywood sex symbol, but also led the way for modern-day action heroines.

programme.title: Mr. Monk's Last Case: A Monk Movie
programme.desc: Monk steps out of retirement as his stepdaughter's wedding turns tragic when her fiancé dies in a bungee jumping accident.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible
programme.desc: Branded a traitor, an elite intelligence agent (Tom Cruise) investigates a failed Prague mission to retrieve a computer disk.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: Sam Witwicky and his new girlfriend, Carly, join the fray when the evil Decepticons renew their longstanding war against the Autobots. The war appears to tip in favor of the Decepticons, leading to a climactic battle in Chicago.

programme.title: The Good Father: The Martin MacNeill Story
programme.desc: Weeks after his wife's suspicious death, Dr. Martin MacNeill moves in his mistress under the guise of a live-in nanny. Shocked by her father's actions, his daughter begins to question everything she's known about him while uncovering a web of lies.

programme.title: White Bird: A Wonder Story
programme.desc: A girl in Nazi-occupied France goes into hiding with help from a schoolmate -- a boy who risks everything to give her the chance to survive. Together, they find first love in a stunning, magical world of their own creation.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible III
programme.desc: Now a trainer for IMF recruits, agent Ethan Hunt squares off against the toughest foe he has ever faced, a ruthless arms and information broker.

programme.title: Heated Rivalry
programme.desc: Two rival hockey stars at the peak of their careers face an unexpected emotional connection, challenging their professional paths and disrupting the sports world's expectations.

programme.title: Heated Rivalry
programme.desc: Shane and Ilya keep their secret fling alive while their growing connection is tested by personal and professional pressures.

programme.title: Michael
programme.desc: The story of pop superstar Michael Jackson, from his extraordinary early days in the Jackson 5 to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fuels a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

programme.title: Priscilla
programme.desc: When teenage Priscilla Beaulieu meets Elvis Presley at a party, the man who is already a meteoric rock 'n' roll superstar becomes someone entirely unexpected in private moments: a thrilling crush, an ally in loneliness, a vulnerable best friend.

programme.title: Drive Back Home
programme.desc: In the winter of 1970, a cantankerous, small town plumber from rural New Brunswick, must drive his beat-up work truck 1000 miles to Toronto to get his estranged, gay brother out of jail after being arrested for having sex in a public park.

programme.title: Corner Gas Animated
programme.desc: Brent and Hank are disappointed to find that their favorite wrestler has become a gardener.

programme.title: Corner Gas Animated
programme.desc: Lacey plans a parade for Dog River Days with all the fixings; Wanda uses a mascot to convince a corporate sponsor to support the cause; Hank battles Emma for the beauty pageant crown.

programme.title: Transplant
programme.desc: Bash's decisions lead to conflict with the new chief of emergency medicine; Mags struggles to save a patient who thinks the system gave up on her; June has trouble with her new roommate, and gets a work proposal from Novak; Theo has trouble adapting.

programme.title: Air Bud
programme.desc: Abandoned by a disagreeable clown (Michael Jeter), a golden retriever with a knack for basketball befriends a lonely boy (Kevin Zegers).

programme.title: Air Bud: Golden Receiver
programme.desc: A golden retriever with a flair for sports helps a boy (Kevin Zegers) handle football and the new boyfriend (Gregory Harrison) of the boy's widowed mother (Cynthia Stevenson).

programme.title: No One Will Save You
programme.desc: Brynn finds solace within the walls of the home where she grew up until she's awakened one night by strange noises from unearthly intruders.

programme.title: Secret Headquarters
programme.desc: When Charlie and his friends discover that his dad is a powerful superhero, the youngsters spring into action to defend his secret headquarters and save the planet from a villainous threat.

programme.title: A Minecraft Movie
programme.desc: A mysterious portal pulls four misfits into the Overworld, a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master the terrain while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected crafter named Steve.

programme.title: GOAT
programme.desc: A small goat named Will gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot to join the pros and play roarball -- a high-intensity, full-contact sport that's dominated by the fastest, fiercest animals in the world.

programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends
programme.desc: After moving to New York City, kung fu prodigy Li Fong enters a karate competition -- but his skills alone aren't enough. With help from Mr. Han and Daniel LaRusso, he soon learns to merge two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Best friends Griff and Doug head to the jungles of the Amazon to film a reboot of their all-time favorite movie "Anaconda." However, life soon imitates art when a gigantic anaconda with a thirst for blood starts hunting them down.

programme.title: Billionaire Murders
programme.desc: A billionaire couple is found murdered in their home and Toronto's premier investigative reporter is on the case.

programme.title: Billionaire Murders
programme.desc: Kevin Donovan pursues potential suspects in the murders of Barry and Honey Sherman, including a cousin of Barry's who's waged a 10-year lawsuit against the billionaire and made remarks expressing violent fantasies about harming him.

programme.title: Memoir of a Snail
programme.desc: After a series of misfortunes, a snail-collecting, melancholic misfit learns how to find confidence within herself amid the clutter of everyday life.

programme.title: Three Thousand Years of Longing
programme.desc: While attending a conference in Istanbul, Dr. Alithea Binnie happens to encounter a djinn who offers her three wishes in exchange for his freedom. Eventually, she's beguiled and makes a wish that surprises them both.

programme.title: Imperfect High
programme.desc: Suffering from anxiety disorder, Hanna worries about fitting in at high school after moving to a new town. She soon finds herself in grave danger when she befriends two students -- a bad boy with a heart of gold, and a wealthy kid.

programme.title: Never Let Go
programme.desc: When an unspeakable evil takes over the world, the only protection for a mother and her twin sons is their house and strong bond. Needing to stay connected at all times, they tether themselves with ropes, clinging to one another and never letting go.

programme.title: Paul Rabliauskas: Uncle
programme.desc: Poplar River First Nation comedian Paul Rabliauskas brings his observational humor to Montreal where he talks about everything from white people and land acknowledgements to being single during the pandemic.

programme.title: Corner Gas Animated
programme.desc: Brent accidentally locks Hank and Wanda in Corner Gas; Emma tries to get out of making Davis's special bread.

programme.title: Corner Gas Animated
programme.desc: Davis tries to get Brent to join his rugby team; Brent's more focused on inventing a new rugby chant; Hank and Karen convince Lacey to start selling pizza in the Ruby.

programme.title: Transplant
programme.desc: Bash treats a man with a rare medical condition; Mags gets a visit from her parents, and goes above and beyond for a pregnant woman with an undiagnosed condition; a misunderstanding with a rabies patient lands Theo in trouble.

programme.title: Air Bud: Seventh Inning Fetch
programme.desc: The golden retriever joins a middle-school baseball team and searches for his missing offspring.

programme.title: Thunderball
programme.desc: Agent 007 (Sean Connery) scuba dives after SPECTRE's Largo (Adolfo Celi) hijacks nuclear bombs with a hydrofoil yacht.

programme.title: Little jesus

programme.title: Transformers: The Last Knight

programme.title: Blizzard
programme.desc: A youngster learns about true friendship with the help of a magically gifted reindeer from the North Pole.

programme.title: Switching Goals
programme.desc: Soccer-playing twins (Mary-Kate Olsen, Ashley Olsen) decide to help their father (Eric Lutes), a coach seeking a seventh championship title.

programme.title: Racetime

programme.title: Where the Wild Things Are
programme.desc: Sent to bed without supper, a mischievous boy enters a land that grows out of his imagination and becomes king of the fantastic creatures who live there.

programme.title: The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey
programme.desc: A reluctant Hobbit, Bilbo Baggins, sets out to the Lonely Mountain with a spirited group of dwarves to reclaim their mountain home, and the gold within it from the dragon Smaug.

programme.title: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug
programme.desc: The dwarves, along with Bilbo Baggins and Gandalf the Grey, continue their quest to reclaim Erebor, their homeland, from Smaug. Bilbo Baggins is in possession of a mysterious and magical ring.

programme.title: The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies
programme.desc: Bilbo and company are forced to engage in a war against an array of combatants and keep the Lonely Mountain from falling into the hands of a rising darkness.

programme.title: The Angry Birds Movie 2
programme.desc: Red, Chuck, Bomb and the rest of their feathered friends unite with the green pigs when aggressive birds from an ice-covered island plan to use an elaborate weapon to destroy them both.

programme.title: H Is for Hawk
programme.desc: After the sudden death of her father, a woman turns to the ancient art of falconry, training a wild goshawk named Mabel to navigate her profound loss.

programme.title: Journey to the Center of the Earth
programme.desc: An anthropologist (Rick Schroder) leads an expedition to an underground world of prehistoric beasts and primitive man.

programme.title: Starbuck
programme.desc: More than 140 people sue a fertility clinic to reveal the name of the sperm donor (Patrick Huard) whose frequent contributions resulted in 533 offspring.

programme.title: Gabrielle
programme.desc: A young woman who has Williams syndrome possesses amazing musical talents but struggles continually to gain her independence.

programme.title: Cooking With Stella
programme.desc: A woman cooks for clients and tries to keep her thefts of food and money from being discovered.

programme.title: Maudie
programme.desc: From childhood to her deathbed, a woman experiences love, loss and discrimination.

programme.title: Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: A poor but hopeful boy seeks one of the five coveted golden tickets that will send him on a tour of Willy Wonka's mysterious chocolate factory.

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
programme.desc: A chosen hobbit (Elijah Wood) and his loyal friends join a wizard (Ian McKellen), humans, a dwarf and an elf on a quest to destroy a powerful ring and defeat an evil lord.

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
programme.desc: Now divided, members of a fellowship take different paths to destroy the ring and defeat evil Sauron and his pawns.

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
programme.desc: Frodo (Elijah Wood) and Sam march toward Mount Doom to destroy the ring, while Gandalf (Ian McKellen) and warriors prepare for a final confrontation with Sauron and his allies.

programme.title: Fightland
programme.desc: Duke prepares for his long-awaited shot at revenge, while others take matters into their own hands.

programme.title: Magic Mike
programme.desc: A male stripper takes a newcomer under his wing and instructs him in the fine arts of partying, picking up women and making plenty of money.

programme.title: Magic Mike XXL
programme.desc: Three years after retiring from stripping, Mike Lane (Channing Tatum) reunites with the rest of the Kings of Tampa (Matt Bomer, Joe Manganiello) for one final, outrageous performance in Myrtle Beach, S.C.

programme.title: Maps to the Stars
programme.desc: Driven by an intense need for fame and validation, members of a dysfunctional Hollywood dynasty have lives as dramatic as any movie.

programme.title: Stories We Tell
programme.desc: Through a series of revealing interviews, filmmaker Sarah Polley investigates the truth about her family history.

programme.title: Paseo
programme.desc: A woman becomes displaced and alienated by her surroundings while traveling through Spain. She begins to lose control of her emotional and psychological self as she explores another possible life.

programme.title: Drink Slay Love
programme.desc: A 16-year-old vampire discovers she has the ability to withstand sunlight. Sensing an opportunity to round up new victims, her family enrolls her in high school, where her who-cares attitude quickly makes her the coolest girl around.

programme.title: Tia and Piujuq
programme.desc: A 10-year-old Syrian refugee living in Montreal finds a magic portal leading to the Arctic.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry's Giant Adventure
programme.desc: Tom and Jerry encounter a grumpy giant after climbing a beanstalk to a magical land.

programme.title: The Wizard of Oz
programme.desc: After a tornado whisks Kansas farm girl Dorothy (Judy Garland) to a magic land, she must travel to the Emerald City for help in getting back home.

programme.title: A League of Their Own
programme.desc: The All-American Girls Professional Baseball League begins in 1943 with a major-league has-been as a manager.

programme.title: Miss Congeniality
programme.desc: An image consultant transforms a tomboyish FBI agent into a beauty queen so she can work undercover to catch a terrorist.

programme.title: The Devil Wears Prada
programme.desc: A recent college graduate lands a job working for a famous and diabolical editor of a New York fashion magazine.

programme.title: Legally Blonde
programme.desc: A sorority queen (Reese Witherspoon) enrolls in Harvard to prove to her former boyfriend that she has more than good looks.

programme.title: Legally Blonde 2: Red, White & Blonde
programme.desc: Fired from her firm, a young Boston lawyer (Reese Witherspoon) heads to Washington, D.C., to fight for animal rights.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: A Beverly Hills teen (Alicia Silverstone) plays matchmaker for teachers, transforms a bad dresser (Brittany Murphy) and examines her own existence.

programme.title: She's All That
programme.desc: A cool teen (Freddie Prinze Jr.) bets a friend that he can transform the school's geekiest girl (Rachael Leigh Cook) into a prom queen.

programme.title: The Spanish Princess
programme.desc: With an heir sleeping in the crib and a powerful alliance made with Spain, glamorous royal couple Catherine and Henry think nothing can go wrong.

programme.title: The Spanish Princess
programme.desc: Henry invades France; Catherine, who is pregnant, tries to defend England from the Scottish king, James IV.

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: A man (James Spader) and wife who get thrills from car accidents hook up with the head (Elias Koteas) of a group that stages famous wrecks.

programme.title: Earth
programme.desc: A young Parsi girl discovers the truth about human nature as friends turn foes while the city is set aflame during partition.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Dr. Magnus and Druitt struggle to come to terms with the apparent death of their daughter; Will, Henry and Bigfoot must organize and process hundreds of surviving Abnormals.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: When a superhero begins to thwart crime in the city, the Sanctuary team must capture him to discover if he is an Abnormal.

programme.title: Milton's Secret
programme.desc: A man (Donald Sutherland) teaches his 11-year-old grandson (William Ainscough) how to cope with bickering parents and the neighborhood bully.

programme.title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: A poor boy (Freddie Highmore) and four spoiled children win a tour through the incredible factory of an odd confectioner (Johnny Depp).

programme.title: Crossroads
programme.desc: Three childhood friends (Britney Spears, Zoe Saldana) rediscover their relationship as they take a cross-country trip with a musician (Anson Mount).

programme.title: Ever After: A Cinderella Story
programme.desc: Treated as a servant by her stepmother (Anjelica Huston), a 16th-century woman (Drew Barrymore) wins the heart of the French prince (Dougray Scott).

programme.title: Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves
programme.desc: The archer and his Moorish companion join Sherwood Forest outlaws to fight against the sheriff of Nottingham, who desires to possess Maid Marian.

programme.title: A Knight's Tale
programme.desc: An English commoner (Heath Ledger) dons the armor of a dead jouster and, with the help of friends (Mark Addy, Paul Bettany, Alan Tudyk), competes against nobles in 14th-century France.

programme.title: 10 Things I Hate About You
programme.desc: A pretty, popular student is not allowed to date until her rebellious older sister gets a suitor of her own.

programme.title: Superbad
programme.desc: Separation anxiety poses a problem for two co-dependent high school seniors who hope to score booze and babes at a party.

programme.title: Can't Hardly Wait
programme.desc: A teen (Ethan Embry) decides to proclaim his love for a classmate (Jennifer Love Hewitt) at their high-school graduation party.

programme.title: The Spanish Princess
programme.desc: As Catherine fights to repair her marriage after another tragedy, Meg must find a way to bring Scotland together after the bloody battle of Flodden.

programme.title: The Spanish Princess
programme.desc: As Meg jeopardizes everything for love, a pregnant Catherine wrestles with the sickening suspicion that Henry is being unfaithful.

programme.title: Being Julia
programme.desc: In 1938 London a theatrical actress (Annette Bening) devises an elaborate scheme against the social climber who used her.

programme.title: River
programme.desc: In the south of Laos, an American volunteer doctor becomes a fugitive after he intervenes in the sexual assault of a young woman.

programme.title: Looney Tunes: Rabbits Run
programme.desc: Bugs Bunny and his friend Lola get into mischief as they travel from New York to Paris in pursuit of an invisibility spray.

programme.title: The Lego Movie
programme.desc: An ordinary LEGO figurine Emmet, thought to be the key to saving the world, is accompanied by a fellowship of strangers embarking on a quest to vanquish a tyrant bent on a terrible deed.

programme.title: The LEGO Batman Movie
programme.desc: There are big changes brewing in Gotham, but if Batman (Will Arnett) wants to save the city from the Joker's hostile takeover, he may have to drop the lone vigilante thing, try to work with others and maybe, just maybe, learn to lighten up.

programme.title: The LEGO NINJAGO Movie
programme.desc: Master Wu, as wise-cracking as he is wise, leads a fierce team of secret ninja warriors to defeat the evil warlord Garmadon and save NINJAGO City.

programme.title: The LEGO Movie 2: The Second Part
programme.desc: The citizens of Bricksburg face a dangerous new threat when LEGO DUPLO invaders from outer space start to wreck everything. It's now up to Emmet, Lucy, Batman and their friends to defeat the giant marauders and restore harmony to the LEGO universe.

programme.title: Minions
programme.desc: On a mission to find a new master to serve, three Minions meet Scarlet Overkill, the world's first female supervillain.

programme.title: Despicable Me
programme.desc: As he tries to execute a fiendish plot to steal the moon, a supervillain meets his match in three little orphan girls who want to make him their dad.

programme.title: Despicable Me 2
programme.desc: Just as Gru settles into his new role as a suburban family man, the ultrasecret Anti-Villain League sends him on a mission to nab the perpetrator of a spectacular heist.

programme.title: Despicable Me 3
programme.desc: Fired from the Anti-Villain League, Gru travels to Freedonia to meet his long-lost twin brother for the first time. The siblings soon find themselves in an uneasy alliance to take down Balthazar Bratt, a former 1980s child star who's out for revenge.

programme.title: Fly Away Home
programme.desc: A Canadian sculptor (Jeff Daniels) builds an ultralight plane so his teen daughter (Anna Paquin) can lead geese south.

programme.title: Amish Affair
programme.desc: Hannah knows her secret relationship with Aaron, a charismatic Amish leader, has them both living in sin, so she decides to end it. However, when Aaron's wife suspiciously dies, she finds herself framed for murder and fighting to prove her innocence.

programme.title: The Death and Life of John F. Donovan
programme.desc: A young actor reminisces about a dead American TV star and the correspondence they shared.

programme.title: Whale
programme.desc: A young boy is sent to live with his grandparents in a remote indigenous community.

programme.title: The Angry Birds Movie 2

programme.title: The Games Maker

programme.title: Meditation Park

programme.title: Mr. Peabody & Sherman
programme.desc: After Sherman (Max Charles) and Penny (Ariel Winter) take his time machine for a joyride, Mr. Peabody (Ty Burrell) must come to the rescue before the past, present and future are changed forever.

programme.title: Babe
programme.desc: An Australian farmer (James Cromwell) adopts a piglet that becomes a champion sheep herder. Live action/animatronics.

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Globe-trotting archaeologist Indiana Jones races the Nazis for possession of a legendary religious artifact.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: In 1935 archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford), a lounge singer (Kate Capshaw) and a Chinese orphan (Ke Huy Quan) search for mystical stones stolen from an Indian tribe.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: Indy (Harrison Ford) and a young adventurer (Shia La Beouf) must ferret out a powerful artifact and keep it out of the hands of a deadly Soviet agent (Cate Blanchett).

programme.title: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, young Lara Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan.

programme.title: Fightland

programme.title: Away From Her
programme.desc: A man (Gordon Pinsent) becomes confused and angry when his wife (Julie Christie), an Alzheimer's patient, seems to prefer the company of another resident at her nursing home.

programme.title: Kalinga (Care)

programme.title: Pour une fois

programme.title: Génial!
programme.desc: Nous commençons notre 17e saison avec une de nos très amusantes compétitions homme-femme, Stéphane a besoin de conseils pour disposer de l'huile de friture souillée de manière responsable, et les dés décident du sort des équipes au Jeu de société.

programme.title: Qui a éclaboussé le ministre?
programme.desc: Le ministre de la Famille vient donner une conférence de presse à l'Académie des Ratons, mais il est victime d'un attentat.

programme.title: Liberté, la statue qui voulait changer le monde
programme.desc: Née d'un projet politique porté par Auguste Bartholdi, la Statue de la Liberté incarne les idéaux républicains. Ce documentaire retrace sa création, les défis de sa construction et les liens historiques entre la France et les États-Unis.

programme.desc: Les émotions et revirements sont au rendez-vous dans cette finale épique ; qui, parmi les cinq finalistes, réussira à être aussi rapide à la course que dans les épreuves cognitives et d'endurance ?

programme.title: Pour une fois
programme.desc: Yves Corbeil, Marie Laberge, Brigitte Boisjoli et Paul Rivard deviennent intervieweurs; leur mission: mettre en lumière différentes facettes de Guy Mongrain.

programme.title: Passe-Partout
programme.desc: Passe-Montagne et Passe-Partout explorent ce qui s'ouvre et se ferme; Grand-Mère raconte l'histoire d'Idra et du roi Nemmpa; Cannelle a hâte de passer la journée seule avec Madame Coucou et Mélodie.

programme.title: Barababor
programme.desc: Barababor raconte les aventures étranges de conquistadors au QI aussi élevé que celui d'une langouste.

programme.title: Les Millimus
programme.desc: Ingéniusse invente un robot qui est capable de faire les tâches des Millimus; à sa grande surprise, il est aussi capable de parler! Stradivarius crée sa première bande dessinée.

programme.title: Les contemporains
programme.desc: Pour la seconde classe de maître, le sculpteur David Altmejd, né à Montréal et maintenant établi à New York, agit cette fois comme mentor pour les six artistes finalistes. Pour s'éloigner du cadre scolaire, David ne leur donne pas de thème.

programme.title: Drazilion
programme.desc: D'étranges glaçons orange sont apparus dans la forêt et Éoline insiste pour que Juliette s'en tienne loin. Tholaf cherche à reprendre les commandes de ses Vikings, bouleversés par les récentes victoires des forces de l'ombre.

programme.title: Super Plex
programme.desc: Super Plex et Piquante doivent sauver la Terre de l'impact d'un astéroïde.

programme.title: Cracké
programme.desc: Ed se fait lentement écraser par une grosse pierre pour sauver ses oeufs.

programme.title: Génial!
programme.desc: On reçoit de véritables scorpions en studio afin de discuter de leur mode de reproduction, Mini Martin et son mentor s'amusent avec une pile, des aimants et du papier aluminium, et on parle d'une couleur qui n'existe pas au Jeu des trappes.

programme.title: Tu m'aimes-tu?
programme.desc: Fred, dévasté par sa peine, n'arrive pas à accepter que Valérie, l'amour de sa vie, l'ait quitté. Son meilleur ami, Dave, propose une solution inattendue pour traverser cette période tumultueuse.

programme.title: Jukebox
programme.desc: On raconte l'histoire méconnue du plus important personnage de la musique populaire des années 60 au Québec: Denis Pantis.

programme.title: Les huîtres d'Anticosti
programme.desc: Rencontre avec John Pineault, copropriétaire de la ferme ostréicole Manowin, sur l'île d'Anticosti.

programme.title: Hors piste: la culture insoumise
programme.desc: Anticonformiste, l'artiste trans Nour Symon crée des tableaux sonores pour les instrumentistes; ielle établit son lexique musical en fonction de l'épaisseur, la couleur et la hauteur de ses traits sur sa toile.

programme.title: Plus rapide que la peur
programme.desc: La détective Sunny Becker reprend son travail au LKA après plusieurs semaines de congé de maladie et doit prendre la direction de la traque du dangereux violeur et meurtrier André Haffner qui vient de s'évader de prison.

programme.title: Y'a du monde à messe
programme.desc: On reçoit Boom Desjardins, Martin Desrosiers, Sylvie Fréchette, Julien Harinen, et Boom Desjardins nous offre un moment musical aussi puissant que rassembleur.

programme.title: Génial!
programme.desc: On reçoit de véritables scorpions en studio afin de discuter de leur mode de reproduction, Mini Martin et son mentor s'amusent avec une pile, des aimants et du papier aluminium, et on parle d'une couleur qui n'existe pas au Jeu des trappes.

programme.title: McSween
programme.desc: Pierre-Yves McSween cuisine avec Emilie Cuizine. Ils discutent de son métier de créatrice de contenu. Avec son nouveau nom de moniteur, Ça paye, Pierre-Yves essaie d'apprendre aux enfants d'un camp de jour quelques connaissances fiscales.

programme.title: 11 septembre minute par minute
programme.desc: Retour minute par minute sur les attentats du 11 septembre 2001; un nouveau regard sous l'angle de la communication frénétique entre le personnel de bord des différents avions, l'armée, les pompiers de New York et le Président Bush.

programme.title: Master Crimes
programme.desc: Louise Arbus se rend sur une scène de crime près de la Tour Eiffel, où une médium célèbre est retrouvée morte en robe de mariée; l'enquête la mène au salon de la voyance; elle plonge alors ses étudiants dans cet univers mystérieux.

programme.title: À quoi tu joues?
programme.desc: Jean-Philippe et Kevin plongent dans l'univers de la série culte d'Akira Toriyama avec "Dragon Ball: Sparking! ZERO"; ils deviennent espions en jouant au classique "Golden Eye 007", et Ariel Charest découvre le travail d'artistes de niveaux.

programme.title: Cochon dingue
programme.desc: Val rencontre le réalisateur Philippe Falardeau; Bario parle de genres cinématographiques; Néo devient un cochon d'Inde géant; les animateurs visitent les salles de cinéma les plus originales, et Momo fait rigoler la bande avec son nouveau jeu.

programme.title: Drazilion
programme.desc: D'étranges glaçons orange sont apparus dans la forêt et Éoline insiste pour que Juliette s'en tienne loin. Tholaf cherche à reprendre les commandes de ses Vikings, bouleversés par les récentes victoires des forces de l'ombre.

programme.title: Les Trois Bricochons
programme.desc: C'est le jour de la cueillette des baies de l'ours. Les Bricochons trouvent un moyen d'aider Bruno à grimper dans l'arbre pour récolter les baies avant qu'elles ne disparaissent.

programme.title: La Pat'Patrouille
programme.desc: Un petit chat s'est égaré ; Ryder et la Pat'Patrouille le cherchent pour le rendre à son propriétaire ; un éboulement a emprisonné Katie et Cali dans un train sur le vieux pont ; Ryder et la Pat'Patrouille arrivent à leur rescousse.

programme.title: L'île Kilucru
programme.desc: Fantomini doit s'occuper de tous les préparatifs pour recevoir le célèbre musicien Omard Récif, qui vient visiter Coralie ce soir; en attendant son ami, la sirène veut absolument se reposer et charge Crrrou de veiller à son repos.

programme.title: Chuggington: en avant les locos
programme.desc: Les aventures des apprentis moteurs Koko, Wilson et Brewster.

programme.title: Les Minus
programme.desc: La théière de Bella a disparu et Titus est soupçonné. Avec Oli, il enquête pour prouver son innocence malgré les Astro-Héros à leurs trousses.
